question: On the site plan, identify the property lines and right-of-way boundaries. For each transformer pad shown, determine whether the transformer pad is located entirely within the private property boundary or if any part of it extends into the public right-of-way or straddles the property line. Provide the location of each transformer pad relative to the nearest property line or ROW edge.
checklistItemText: Transformer pads not located 100% on private property, located in public right-of-way, or straddling property lines
classifierReasoning: The agent is asking for spatial positioning of transformer pads relative to property lines and ROW boundaries, which requires measuring/determining whether features fall within or outside defined boundaries — a clearance/containment measurement task.
